parsed.scene_description: A warehouse interior with tall metal shelving units filled with cardboard boxes. In the foreground, a large metal cage pallet with a grid pattern holds stacked items wrapped in plastic. A forklift is partially visible on the right. The floor is concrete, and lighting fixtures are overhead.

objects.label: metal cage pallet
objects.observation: Large rectangular metal cage with a grid pattern, containing stacked items wrapped in clear plastic. Positioned centrally in the foreground. Contacts the concrete floor via wooden pallet base. Partially obscures background shelves.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Multiple cardboard boxes of varying sizes stored on high metal shelves in the background. Some have green labels. Boxes are stacked neatly on pallets. Visible behind the cage pallet.

objects.label: metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall industrial metal shelving units extending from ceiling to floor, holding boxes. Located in the background. Structurally supported by vertical beams. Partially obscured by the cage pallet.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Red forklift partially visible on the right side of the frame, near the shelves. Its forks are down. Appears stationary. Behind the cage pallet and partially blocked by it.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: Smooth gray concrete floor covering the entire ground area. Reflects some light. Supports all objects including the cage pallet and shelving units.
